objective: Let a person record the commercial actions that happen after execution has begun, so a deal can move past its first move. `recordAction` (server/repos/cashActions.ts:61) has exactly one caller: the first action inside `beginExecution` (server/services/cash/opportunities.ts ~558), which only moves READY -> EXECUTING. There is no way to record QUOTE_AND_INVOICE, ACCEPT_PAYMENT or any later action on an EXECUTING or DELIVERING opportunity, so dealflow's QUOTING stage (server/services/dealflow/maturity.ts ACTION_STAGE ~98-101, fed by actionsFor in dealflow/kernel.ts ~220) is unreachable in practice, and the Cash page only offers 'Record the first move' (client/src/russell/Cash.tsx ~2385, client/src/lib/cashApi.ts ~790).
expectedOutcome: A new service function records a further PERSON-performed commercial action on an opportunity that is EXECUTING or DELIVERING: it checks the action is one of COMMERCIAL_ACTIONS, checks the standing commercial authority for that action with checkCommercialAuthority exactly as beginExecution does, is idempotent by a request key built from the opportunity, the action and an occurrence, records a CASH_ACTION_RECORDED event, and moves no state. It is served by a route behind requirePerson and project WRITE (a worker principal refused by type, a project the caller cannot see answered with the same 404 as a missing one), and the Cash page offers the control on an executing or delivering opportunity, disabled with the server's reason when the grant does not cover the action. Recording QUOTE_AND_INVOICE on a deal's opportunity makes the dealflow stage read QUOTING.
nonGoals: Brain recording any action by itself; this is a person's record only.
Performing any external effect, issuing an invoice, or moving money.
Changing beginExecution's first-action path, the ceilings, or the ledger.
Adding NEGOTIATING, which stays unobservable because no commercial action means it.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A test records QUOTE_AND_INVOICE on an EXECUTING opportunity through the HTTP route and asserts one cash_actions row, one CASH_ACTION_RECORDED event, unchanged opportunity state, and that repeating the request with the same occurrence records nothing new.

The route refuses an action the standing grant does not cover, an opportunity that is READY or terminal, an action outside COMMERCIAL_ACTIONS, and a worker principal; a caller without access gets a 404 byte-identical to a non-existent opportunity.
A dealflow test asserts a deal whose opportunity has a recorded QUOTE_AND_INVOICE after CONTACT_BUYER reads stage QUOTING.
A component test drives the Cash page control and asserts the request it posts and the disabled reason it shows when the server offers none.
The repository typechecks and the existing cash and dealflow suites pass.

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. No schema change; the new path only appends to cash_actions and cash_events.
